name: Cumin-Lime Wings with Potato, Green Bean, Tomato, Olive & Feta Salad

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F). Line two baking sheet pans with aluminum foil to make clean up easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ limes
0.68 kg new potatoes
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 ½ jalapeño peppers
1 small bunch cilantro
0.68 kg green beans

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a large bowl. Add oil and spices, then whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
¾ tsp coriander, ground
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken wings dry with paper towels and add to the bowl with the marinade. Toss to coat, transfer to the baking sheets, and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.36 kg chicken wings, split with tips removed

instructions.primary_message: Place wings in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, turning once, until cooked through, 25-30 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, halve new potatoes; place in a large pot, along with salt, and cover with hot water (from the tap). Bring to a boil, reduce heat to low, and simmer until almost fork-tender, about 10 minutes.
While the potatoes are cooking, place oil, vinegar, and spices in a clean large bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tbsp white wine vinegar
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Quarter jalapeño peppers lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Small dice and add to the bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl and set aside.

Trim and cut green beans crosswise into 1-inch pieces. When the potatoes are just tender, add beans to the pot. Continue to cook until potatoes and beans are fork-tender, 3-4 minutes more. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool.
Roughly chop olives. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with cooled potatoes, green beans, and feta, then stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
1 ½ (113 g) pkgs crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide wings and salad between plates. Enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: chicken wings, split with tips removed
